CarWeight.description:
Car weights by category. Trailing tons = freight x (1 + empty car tons / cargo tons
per car); they give the locomotive count and a run's freight limit. Schedule tonnage is
freight, except on a circuitous train's way back (its empty cars).

empty_car_tons_by_category.description: Tons of one empty car. 0 = freight only.
empty_car_tons_by_category.title: Empty Car Tons By Category

cargo_tons_per_car_by_category.description: Tons of freight in one loaded car.
cargo_tons_per_car_by_category.title: Cargo Tons Per Car By Category

CarWeight.title: CarWeight

CircuitousTrains.description:
Trains sent straight back to their origin as the same symbol, with their empty cars and
the locomotives of their heaviest leg, to reduce the locomotive imbalance. Chosen one at a
time, the most helpful first, within each category's share; a return that does not help,
or does not fit in the week, is not added.

short_empty_returns.description: Per category, e.g. {M: 0.5}: share of its short trains (at most `short_max_miles` one way) that may come back; unlisted get none.
short_empty_returns.title: Short Empty Returns

long_empty_returns.description: Per category: share of its long trains that may come back; unlisted get none.
long_empty_returns.title: Long Empty Returns

short_max_miles.description: One-way miles up to which a train is short.
short_max_miles.title: Short Max Miles

CircuitousTrains.title: CircuitousTrains

train_start.description: Cost of one run of a train.
train_start.title: Train Start

per_train_mile.description: Cost per mile of one run, over its whole route.
per_train_mile.title: Per Train Mile

per_distinct_train.description: Weekly charge for each service (yard pair and train type) that runs at all. 0 leaves out its binary variables.
per_distinct_train.title: Per Distinct Train

transfer_fixed.description: Cost of each change of train of a commodity at a yard.
transfer_fixed.title: Transfer Fixed

transfer_per_ton.description: Added per ton/week of the commodity that changes trains. Both 0 leaves out the transfer variables.
transfer_per_ton.title: Transfer Per Ton

CrewRule.description: Crew changes placed after the model along each selected train.

duty_hours.description: On-duty limit of a crew, in hours.
duty_hours.title: Duty Hours

terminal_hours.description: On-duty time not spent running; usable hours = duty_hours - terminal_hours.
terminal_hours.title: Terminal Hours

merge_with_work_stop_minutes.description: A crew change that falls at most this many minutes' run after a work stop is moved back to that stop.
merge_with_work_stop_minutes.title: Merge With Work Stop Minutes

CrewRule.title: CrewRule

DwellMinutes.description:
Dwell at an intermediate stop, in minutes, by the events that happen there. A stop
with no event has no dwell.
DwellMinutes.title: DwellMinutes

ExcludedFlow.description: FAF rows removed from demand: origin zone, destination zone, SCTG codes, and why.
ExcludedFlow.title: ExcludedFlow

train_seed.description: Seed for the random parts of train generation; null draws a new one each run.
train_seed.title: Train Seed

data_output_dir.description: Directory that generated data is written to.
data_output_dir.title: Data Output Dir

seg_freq_arc_cost_discount_alpha.description: Weight α of the phase-2 discount on busy segments.
seg_freq_arc_cost_discount_alpha.title: Seg Freq Arc Cost Discount Alpha

lambda.description: Exponent λ of the phase-2 discount on busy segments.
lambda.title: Lambda

median_f.description: Reference count of the phase-2 discount; meant to be the median phase-1 path count over the segments used.
median_f.title: Median F

state.description: Two-letter US state code normalized to uppercase.
state.title: State

LocomotivePower.description:
Locomotives on a leg = hp per ton x trailing tons / `locomotive_hp`, rounded up.
hp per ton = max(category value, (`rolling_resistance_lb_per_ton` + 20 x ruling grade %)
x `min_speed_mph` / (375 x `transmission_efficiency`)).

hp_per_ton_by_category.description: hp per trailing ton by category.
hp_per_ton_by_category.title: Hp Per Ton By Category

rolling_resistance_lb_per_ton.description: Level-track resistance at low speed, lb per ton.
rolling_resistance_lb_per_ton.title: Rolling Resistance Lb Per Ton

min_speed_mph.description: Slowest speed accepted on a leg's ruling grade.
min_speed_mph.title: Min Speed Mph

transmission_efficiency.description: Share of a locomotive's horsepower that reaches the rails.
transmission_efficiency.title: Transmission Efficiency

grade_window_km.description: Length (km) of windows over which to measure a track's ruling grade. If a track is shorter than this distance, it is given a grade of zero.
grade_window_km.title: Grade Window Km

LocomotivePower.title: LocomotivePower

hub_locations.description: Hub cities that phase-1 routes run between their hub yards.
hub_locations.title: Hub Locations

hub_radius_km.description: A hub city's hub: the largest zone yard of its state within this many km of the city.
hub_radius_km.title: Hub Radius Km

yds_per_zone.description: Most yards that represent one FAF zone.
yds_per_zone.title: Yds Per Zone

min_od_yd_spacing_km.description: Least track distance (km) between two yards of the same zone.
min_od_yd_spacing_km.title: Min Od Yd Spacing Km

min_od_yd_track_km.description: Least track length (km) of a zone's yard; waived for a zone with no candidate that large.
min_od_yd_track_km.title: Min Od Yd Track Km

excluded_track_net_codes.description: NTAD `NET` codes of lines the network walk skips: A abandoned, R removed, X out of service, T trail, F ferry. Applied when `graph.gexf` is built.
excluded_track_net_codes.title: Excluded Track Net Codes

max_connection_km.description: Longest yard-to-yard connection kept on load; longer ones are mostly routes through Canada or Mexico, which have no yards.
max_connection_km.title: Max Connection Km

od_discount_factor.description: Phase-1 cost factor on connections at a zone yard (0.7 = 30% cheaper).
od_discount_factor.title: Od Discount Factor

per_grade_speed_reduction.description: Share of speed lost per 1% of uphill grade.
per_grade_speed_reduction.title: Per Grade Speed Reduction

max_speed_reduction.description: Largest share of speed lost on a grade.
max_speed_reduction.title: Max Speed Reduction

RegionSettings.description: Which part of the network an instance covers (`regions.py`).

instance.description: full: the whole network. east / west: flows within the side, or between a gateway and the side, are kept whole; gateway-to-gateway flows go to the side with most of their route; crossing flows are cut where they reach the other side (`regions.py`).
instance.title: Instance

west_states.description: States of the West (west bank of the Mississippi, Wisconsin, and everything west); the rest is the East.
west_states.title: West States

gateway_zones.description: FAF zones of the gateway cities, in both regions: Chicago (171, 181), St. Louis (172, 292), Kansas City (201, 291), Memphis (471), New Orleans (223).
gateway_zones.title: Gateway Zones

gateway_radius_km.description: Yards within this many km of a gateway zone's yard are in both regions.
gateway_radius_km.title: Gateway Radius Km

RegionSettings.title: RegionSettings

ServiceDesignSettings.description: All knobs of the service-design generator.

multimodal_rail_share.description: Share of a FAF 'multiple modes' row's tons that moves by rail (the intermodal group).
multimodal_rail_share.title: Multimodal Rail Share

multimodal_min_miles.description: Multiple-modes rows count only on zone pairs averaging at least this many miles (FAF5); pairs with no FAF5 distance are dropped. 0 counts all.
multimodal_min_miles.title: Multimodal Min Miles

multimodal_max_miles.description: Multiple-modes rows do not count on zone pairs averaging more than this many miles (coast to coast is not one train). 0 = no limit.
multimodal_max_miles.title: Multimodal Max Miles

excluded_zones.description: FAF zones whose rows are dropped, as origin or destination. 020 Alaska: its track is not connected to the rest.
excluded_zones.title: Excluded Zones

freight_groups.description: SCTG2 codes of each freight group (rail rows); unlisted codes are manifest, multiple-modes rows intermodal.
freight_groups.title: Freight Groups

shared_bulk.description: true: the B groups of a zone pair are one flow and ride `bulk` trains; false: each group is its own flow, on its own trains (coal on coal trains, ...), and must reach `min_od_tons_per_week` alone.
shared_bulk.title: Shared Bulk

train_type_category.description: Output category (A/M/B/I, the symbol prefix) of each freight group and its train type. Each group rides only its own train type; each category is solved on its own.
train_type_category.title: Train Type Category

excluded_flows.description: FAF flows left out of demand (origin zone, destination zone, SCTG codes), with a reason for the report.
excluded_flows.title: Excluded Flows

intra_zone_min_miles.description: Intra-zone FAF rows averaging fewer miles (FAF5) are local switching and dropped; rows with no FAF5 distance are kept.
intra_zone_min_miles.title: Intra Zone Min Miles

min_od_tons_per_week.description: Per category: a train type's tons/week on a zone pair below this are dropped, before the yard-pair split (without `shared_bulk`, each B group on its own); unlisted categories keep all.
min_od_tons_per_week.title: Min Od Tons Per Week

work_yards_per_state.description: Besides zone yards, the N largest yards per state may host work events.
work_yards_per_state.title: Work Yards Per State

max_trailing_tons_per_run_by_category.description: Max trailing tons (freight + cars) of a run on any leg, by category; the freight limit is this / (1 + empty car tons / cargo tons per car).
max_trailing_tons_per_run_by_category.title: Max Trailing Tons Per Run By Category

max_runs_per_week.description: Most runs a week of one symbol (one a day); a service's runs are split into symbols of this many.
max_runs_per_week.title: Max Runs Per Week

max_symbols_per_service.description: Most parallel symbols of one service. Runs are at most max_runs_per_week x max_symbols_per_service, or more if its own freight needs more.
max_symbols_per_service.title: Max Symbols Per Service

ServiceDesignSettings.title: ServiceDesignSettings

SolverSettings.description: Gurobi settings, for each category's model.

time_limit_s.description: Time limit of each category's solve (s); the best solution found is used.
time_limit_s.title: Time Limit S

mip_gap.description: Relative gap at which a category's solve stops.
mip_gap.title: Mip Gap

log_file.description: null: console only. Otherwise each category logs to gurobi_<category>.log in the run's folder under gurobi_solutions/ (this name is not used).
log_file.title: Log File

SolverSettings.title: SolverSettings

speed_km_h.description: Speed (km/h) for the routing costs and the minutes of `distance_matrix.csv`; it does not change the routes.
speed_km_h.title: Speed Km H

speed_km_h_by_category.description: Average speed (km/h) of a train of each category between yards, delays on the line included; sets the schedule's times and crew changes.
speed_km_h_by_category.title: Speed Km H By Category

YardPairRule.description: Which of a zone pair's candidate yard pairs carry its tons.

assignment.description: split_by_tonnage: n = min(max_pairs, ceil(tons / tonnage_step)) yard pairs, each category split over them by yard size. one_per_category: one yard pair per category, the largest pair (origin x destination track) to the heaviest category.
assignment.title: Assignment

tonnage_step.description: split_by_tonnage only: tons/week per extra yard pair.
tonnage_step.title: Tonnage Step

distance_tolerance.description: Between two zones, yard pairs whose route cost is over (1 + this) x the cheapest are left out.
distance_tolerance.title: Distance Tolerance

min_route_km.description: Local-train distance (km). Inter-zone: yard pairs with a shorter route are not candidates; a zone pair with none left is dropped. Intra-zone: tons whose assigned yard pair is shorter are dropped.
min_route_km.title: Min Route Km

YardPairRule.title: YardPairRule

service_design_settings.description: Settings of the train generator (service network design).
